description: This file defines the registration page route for a web application built using Remix and React. It includes server-side loaders and actions for handling user registration, as well as the React component rendering the registration form UI.

methods.name: loader
methods.description: Server-side loader to redirect logged-in users away from the registration page.

methods.name: action
methods.description: Server-side action to process registration form submissions and handle errors.

methods.name: RegisterPage
methods.description: React component rendering the registration form UI with form handling logic.
